subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution.’

She __is the eldest__ member of our town.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase to be substituted in the above sentence is **"is the oldest"**.
 
• **"Eldest"** is a superlative adjective, used to compare three or more people or things in a group.
 
• **"Oldest"** is the superlative adjective, used to indicate that someone has the greatest age among a group.
 
 
• **Example**: *My grandmother is the oldest member of our family.*
 
 
 
• Hence,** "is the oldest"** is the correct phrase to be substituted.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**.

**Correct Sentence**: "She **is the oldest**__ member of our town."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Elder"** is incorrect because it is used to compare two people or things in a group.
 
• **"Old"** is incorrect because it lacks the comparative or superlative form required for this sentence.
